scope: Generated common OBJECTS owner-reference identity transport.

format_evidence.source: Autodesk DXF Group Codes in Numerical Order Reference
format_evidence.supports: Group codes 330–339 are soft-pointer handles to objects in the same drawing. The library's OBJECTS owner helper emits the supplied parent handle using group 330.

mapping_policy: For a nonzero object parent handle on R14+ DXF, use the configured reference resolver when present; otherwise use remapObjectHandle. Refuse a zero or NoHandle result for a nonzero source. The existing root-dictionary fallback for absent owners and pre-R14 omission are unchanged.

validation.input: Generated in-memory owner handle; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
controls: Exact group-330 output under resolver precedence and source-handle-remap fallback
Unresolved nonzero owner refuses before writing bytes
Corrected output succeeds with a fresh writer

qualification_limits: Generated low-level transport only; it does not prove target existence or that the target is the correct owner for the object.
Does not establish recursive graph closure, physical producer breadth, native consumer behavior, or support-claim eligibility.
